items.title: How Houston’s Biggest Industry Created Opportunities for Another
items.author: Aliza Abidi
items.content: Houston's oil-and-gas industry has built an ecosystem that extends beyond energy. For proof of that, look no further than Bristol Myers Squibb's new pharmaceutical plant.

items.title: New Grid Rules on Texas Data Center Growth
items.author: Aliza Abidi
items.content: Texas energy officials address concerns over rising costs due to rapid data center development.
